resources.string: Li brings ZIP compression and extraction to Giant Explorer. Select your files in Giant to get started.

Pack files
Bundle files or folders into a ZIP archive.

Extract archives
Choose a ZIP file and a destination for its contents.
This app provides guidance. Giant Explorer handles file selection, destinations and task progress.

01 Add the plugin
Import the Li GEP package in Giant’s plugin manager.

02 Choose an action
Open the file action menu and choose compress or extract to under archive.

03 Set a destination
Follow the destination prompt and check progress in background tasks.
